modules.game.ranked:
-- Scoreosis ranked contract v1. The client and the Scoreosis verifier run this
-- same module, so every rule here decides verified scores and achievements.
local cfg = require "game.config"
local rng_module = require "game.rng"
local simulation = require "game.simulation"

local M = {}

M.contract = 1
M.buttons = 4

local BUTTONS = {
	{ "ship_a_left", 1 },
	{ "ship_a_right", 2 },
	{ "ship_b_left", 4 },
	{ "ship_b_right", 8 },
}

M.achievements = {
	{ id = "survive_60", fact = "survival_ticks", mode = "run", gte = 3600, name = "Holding Orbit", description = "Survive 60 active seconds in one run." },
	{ id = "survive_120", fact = "survival_ticks", mode = "run", gte = 7200, name = "Long Watch", description = "Survive 120 active seconds in one run." },
	{ id = "score_5000", fact = "score", mode = "run", gte = 5000, name = "Five Grand", description = "Score at least 5,000 in one run." },
	{ id = "score_20000", fact = "score", mode = "run", gte = 20000, name = "Planet Saver", description = "Score at least 20,000 in one run." },
	{ id = "kills_1", fact = "kills", mode = "run", gte = 1, name = "First Rock", description = "Earn the first credited asteroid kill." },
	{ id = "kills_100", fact = "kills", mode = "total", gte = 100, name = "Rock Breaker", description = "Earn 100 credited asteroid kills." },
	{ id = "kills_1000", fact = "kills", mode = "total", gte = 1000, name = "Quarry Master", description = "Earn 1,000 credited asteroid kills." },
	{ id = "large_kill", fact = "large_kills", mode = "run", gte = 1, name = "Giant Slayer", description = "Earn a credited large-asteroid kill." },
	{ id = "steroid", fact = "steroids", mode = "run", gte = 1, name = "Overdrive", description = "Activate steroid overdrive." },
	{ id = "mastery_3", fact = "mastery", mode = "run", gte = 3, name = "Pattern Reader", description = "Earn three mastery bonuses in one run." },
	{ id = "close_saves_10", fact = "close_saves", mode = "run", gte = 10, name = "Last Second", description = "Make 10 close saves in one run." },
	{ id = "fleet_60", fact = "fleet_ticks", mode = "run", gte = 3600, name = "Full Fleet", description = "Survive 60 active seconds without losing either ship." },
}

local function new_facts()
	return { survival_ticks = 0, kills = 0, large_kills = 0, steroids = 0, mastery = 0, fleet_ticks = 0 }
end

-- Ranked play always uses the reference arena; wider screens only change
-- presentation. Local play passes { local_arena = true } to keep its own width.
function M.new(seed, options)
	if not (options and options.local_arena) then cfg.set_world_width(cfg.width) end
	return { state = simulation.new_game(seed), facts = new_facts(), input = {} }
end

-- Button bitmask for an input table keyed like simulation's input.
function M.bits(input)
	local bits = 0
	for i = 1, #BUTTONS do
		if input[BUTTONS[i][1]] then bits = bits + BUTTONS[i][2] end
	end
	return bits
end

function M.step(sim, bits)
	local input = sim.input
	for i = 1, #BUTTONS do
		local name, bit = BUTTONS[i][1], BUTTONS[i][2]
		input[name] = bits % (bit * 2) >= bit
	end
	local state, facts = sim.state, sim.facts
	-- The control tutorial is not survival time.
	local was_playing = state.status == "playing" and not state.tutorial
	simulation.step(state, input, cfg.fixed_dt)
	if was_playing then
		facts.survival_ticks = facts.survival_ticks + 1
		if state.stats.ships_lost == 0 then facts.fleet_ticks = facts.fleet_ticks + 1 end
	end
	for _, event in ipairs(state.events) do
		local kind = event.kind
		if kind == "asteroid_destroyed" and event.owner ~= nil then
			facts.kills = facts.kills + 1
			if event.tier == "large" then facts.large_kills = facts.large_kills + 1 end
		elseif kind == "steroid_started" then
			facts.steroids = facts.steroids + 1
		elseif kind == "mastery_bonus" then
			facts.mastery = facts.mastery + 1
		end
	end
end

function M.finished(sim)
	return sim.state.status ~= "playing"
end

function M.facts(sim)
	local facts = {}
	for name, value in pairs(sim.facts) do facts[name] = value end
	facts.score = sim.state.score
	facts.close_saves = sim.state.stats.close_saves
	return facts
end

local function copy(value)
	if type(value) ~= "table" then return value end
	local out = {}
	for k, v in pairs(value) do out[k] = copy(v) end
	return out
end

function M.save(sim)
	local state = sim.state
	local rng, events = state.rng, state.events
	state.rng, state.events = nil, nil
	local data = { state = copy(state), rng = rng.state, facts = copy(sim.facts) }
	state.rng, state.events = rng, events
	return data
end

function M.load(data)
	cfg.set_world_width(cfg.width)
	local state = copy(data.state)
	state.rng = rng_module.new(1)
	state.rng.state = data.rng
	state.events = {}
	return { state = state, facts = copy(data.facts), input = {} }
end

return M
modules.game.simulation:
local cfg = require "game.config"
local rng_module = require "game.rng"
local dm = require "scoreosis.detmath"

local M = {}

local TAU = math.pi * 2
local atan2 = dm.atan2

local function clamp(v, a, b)
	return math.max(a, math.min(b, v))
end

local function length_sq(x, y)
	return x * x + y * y
end

local function distance_sq(a, b)
	return length_sq(a.x - b.x, a.y - b.y)
end

local function emit(state, kind, data)
	data = data or {}
	data.kind = kind
	state.events[#state.events + 1] = data
end

local function next_id(state)
	state.next_id = state.next_id + 1
	return state.next_id
end

local function wrap(body)
	if body.x < cfg.world_left then body.x = body.x + cfg.world_width end
	if body.x > cfg.world_right then body.x = body.x - cfg.world_width end
	if body.y < 0 then body.y = body.y + cfg.height end
	if body.y > cfg.height then body.y = body.y - cfg.height end
end

local function segment_circle_t(x1, y1, x2, y2, cx, cy, radius)
	local dx, dy = x2 - x1, y2 - y1
	local fx, fy = x1 - cx, y1 - cy
	local a = dx * dx + dy * dy
	local c = fx * fx + fy * fy - radius * radius
	if c <= 0 then return 0 end
	if a < 0.000001 then return nil end
	local b = 2 * (fx * dx + fy * dy)
	local discriminant = b * b - 4 * a * c
	if discriminant < 0 then return nil end
	local t = (-b - math.sqrt(discriminant)) / (2 * a)
	return t >= 0 and t <= 1 and t or nil
end

local function segment_circle(x1, y1, x2, y2, cx, cy, radius)
	return segment_circle_t(x1, y1, x2, y2, cx, cy, radius) ~= nil
end

local function new_ship(index, x, y, angle)
	return {
		index = index,
		x = x,
		y = y,
		angle = angle,
		radius = cfg.ship.radius,
		alive = true,
		fire_cd = 0.22 + index * 0.16,
		respawn_timer = 0,
		rebuild_reserved = false,
		invulnerable = 0,
		armor = true,
		weapon = "normal",
		weapon_timer = 0,
	}
end

local function spawn_asteroid(state, tier, x, y, vx, vy, encounter_id)
	if #state.asteroids >= cfg.limits.asteroids then return nil end
	local spec = cfg.asteroids[tier]
	local asteroid = {
		id = next_id(state),
		tier = tier,
		x = x,
		y = y,
		vx = vx,
		vy = vy,
		radius = spec.radius,
		hp = spec.hp,
		max_hp = spec.hp,
		spin = state.rng:range(-1.8, 1.8),
		rotation = state.rng:range(0, TAU),
		collision_cd = 0,
		player_tag_owner = nil,
		player_tag_timer = 0,
		encounter_id = encounter_id,
		dead = false,
	}
	state.asteroids[#state.asteroids + 1] = asteroid
	emit(state, "asteroid_spawned", { id = asteroid.id, tier = tier })
	return asteroid
end

local function split_velocity(state, asteroid, offset)
	local speed = math.sqrt(asteroid.vx * asteroid.vx + asteroid.vy * asteroid.vy)
	local angle = atan2(asteroid.vy, asteroid.vx) + offset
	local boost = speed * 1.12 + state.rng:range(8, 25)
	return dm.cos(angle) * boost, dm.sin(angle) * boost
end

local function spawn_pickup(state, x, y, forced)
	if #state.pickups >= cfg.limits.pickups then return end
	local kind = forced
	if not kind then
		local roll = state.rng:next()
		if state.rebuilds < 2 and roll < 0.28 then
			kind = "life"
		elseif state.planet_integrity < 58 and roll < 0.52 then
			kind = "repair"
		else
			local choices = {
				"armor", "armor",
				"rapid", "rapid", "rapid",
				"spread", "spread", "spread",
				"steroid",
			}
			kind = state.rng:pick(choices)
		end
	end
	local angle = state.rng:range(0, TAU)
	state.pickups[#state.pickups + 1] = {
		id = next_id(state),
		kind = kind,
		x = x,
		y = y,
		vx = dm.cos(angle) * 24,
		vy = dm.sin(angle) * 24,
		radius = 24,
		life = cfg.pickups.lifetime,
	}
	emit(state, "pickup_spawned", { pickup = kind })
end

local function score_destroy(state, asteroid, source, owner)
	local direct_weapon = source == "bullet"
	local tagged_collision = source == "collision"
		and asteroid.player_tag_timer > 0
		and asteroid.player_tag_owner ~= nil
	if not direct_weapon and not tagged_collision then
		return 0, nil
	end
	owner = owner or asteroid.player_tag_owner
	local base = cfg.asteroids[asteroid.tier].score
	if direct_weapon and state.combo_timer > 0 then
		state.combo = math.min(8, state.combo + 1)
	else
		state.combo = 1
	end
	state.combo_timer = 2.2
	local multiplier = tagged_collision and 0.5 or 1
	local amount = math.floor(base * (1 + (state.combo - 1) * 0.25) * multiplier)
	local close_limit = cfg.planet_radius + 150
	local close_save = direct_weapon
		and length_sq(asteroid.x - cfg.cx, asteroid.y - cfg.cy) <= close_limit * close_limit
	if close_save then
		amount = amount + base
		state.stats.close_saves = state.stats.close_saves + 1
	end
	state.score = state.score + amount
	if direct_weapon then
		state.pickup_meter = state.pickup_meter + ({ small = 1, medium = 3, large = 7 })[asteroid.tier]
	end
	emit(state, "score", {
		amount = amount,
		combo = state.combo,
		owner = owner,
		source = tagged_collision and "tagged_collision" or source,
		close_save = close_save,
	})
	return amount, owner
end

local function destroy_asteroid(state, asteroid, source, owner)
	if asteroid.dead then return end
	asteroid.dead = true
	local reward, credited_owner = score_destroy(state, asteroid, source, owner)
	emit(state, "asteroid_destroyed", {
		id = asteroid.id,
		tier = asteroid.tier,
		x = asteroid.x,
		y = asteroid.y,
		source = source,
		owner = credited_owner,
		reward = reward,
	})
	if asteroid.tier == "large" then
		for _, offset in ipairs({ -0.48, 0.48 }) do
			local vx, vy = split_velocity(state, asteroid, offset)
			spawn_asteroid(state, "medium", asteroid.x, asteroid.y, vx, vy, asteroid.encounter_id)
		end
	elseif asteroid.tier == "medium" then
		for _, offset in ipairs({ -0.66, 0.66 }) do
			local vx, vy = split_velocity(state, asteroid, offset)
			spawn_asteroid(state, "small", asteroid.x, asteroid.y, vx, vy, asteroid.encounter_id)
		end
	end
	if asteroid.tier == "large" and state.phase == 1 then
		state.phase = 2
		emit(state, "phase_advanced", { phase = 2 })
	end
	if state.pickup_meter >= cfg.pickups.meter then
		state.pickup_meter = state.pickup_meter - cfg.pickups.meter
		spawn_pickup(state, asteroid.x, asteroid.y)
	end
end

local function damage_asteroid(state, asteroid, amount, source, owner)
	if asteroid.dead then return end
	if source == "bullet" then
		asteroid.player_tag_owner = owner
		asteroid.player_tag_timer = 2.5
	end
	asteroid.hp = asteroid.hp - amount
	emit(state, "asteroid_hit", { id = asteroid.id, x = asteroid.x, y = asteroid.y, tier = asteroid.tier })
	if asteroid.hp <= 0 then destroy_asteroid(state, asteroid, source, owner) end
end

local function game_over(state, reason)
	if state.status == "game_over" then return end
	state.status = "game_over"
	state.game_over_reason = reason
	emit(state, "game_over", {
		reason = reason,
		score = state.score,
		last_loss_reason = state.last_loss_reason,
		stats = state.stats,
	})
end

local function steroid_active(ship)
	return ship.weapon == "steroid" and ship.weapon_timer > 0
end

local function kill_ship(state, ship, reason, attacker)
	if not ship.alive or ship.invulnerable > 0 then return false end
	if state.tutorial then return false end
	if steroid_active(ship) then return false end
	if ship.armor then
		ship.armor = false
		local friendly = reason == "friendly_fire"
		ship.invulnerable = friendly and cfg.ship.friendly_fire_grace or 0.45
		emit(state, "armor_broken", {
			ship = ship.index,
			x = ship.x,
			y = ship.y,
			reason = reason,
			attacker = attacker,
		})
		return false
	end
	ship.alive = false
	state.stats.ships_lost = state.stats.ships_lost + 1
	if reason == "friendly_fire" then
		state.stats.friendly_fire = state.stats.friendly_fire + 1
	end
	ship.rebuild_reserved = state.rebuilds > 0
	if ship.rebuild_reserved then
		state.rebuilds = state.rebuilds - 1
		ship.respawn_timer = cfg.ship.respawn_delay
	else
		ship.respawn_timer = -1
	end
	ship.weapon = "normal"
	ship.weapon_timer = 0
	state.last_loss_reason = reason
	state.combo = 0
	state.combo_timer = 0
	emit(state, "ship_destroyed", {
		ship = ship.index,
		x = ship.x,
		y = ship.y,
		reason = reason,
		attacker = attacker,
		respawn_timer = ship.respawn_timer,
		rebuilds = state.rebuilds,
	})
	return true
end

local function respawn_ship(state, ship)
	if not ship.rebuild_reserved then
		ship.respawn_timer = -1
		return
	end
	local side = ship.index == 1 and -1 or 1
	ship.x = cfg.cx + side * 360
	ship.y = cfg.cy + (ship.index == 1 and -180 or 180)
	ship.angle = ship.index == 1 and -0.66 or math.pi - 0.66
	ship.alive = true
	ship.rebuild_reserved = false
	ship.invulnerable = cfg.ship.invulnerable_time
	ship.fire_cd = 0.35
	ship.respawn_timer = 0
	emit(state, "ship_respawned", { ship = ship.index, rebuilds = state.rebuilds })
end

local function fire_bullet(state, ship, angle, damage)
	if #state.bullets >= cfg.limits.bullets then return end
	local dx, dy = dm.cos(angle), dm.sin(angle)
	state.bullets[#state.bullets + 1] = {
		id = next_id(state),
		owner = ship.index,
		x = ship.x + dx * 29,
		y = ship.y + dy * 29,
		prev_x = ship.x + dx * 29,
		prev_y = ship.y + dy * 29,
		vx = dx * cfg.ship.bullet_speed,
		vy = dy * cfg.ship.bullet_speed,
		angle = angle,
		radius = damage and damage > 1 and 7 or 5,
		damage = damage or 1,
		steroid = damage and damage > 1 or false,
		life = cfg.ship.bullet_life,
		dead = false,
	}
end

local function begin_steroid(state, ship)
	ship.weapon = "steroid"
	ship.weapon_timer = cfg.pickups.steroid_duration
	ship.fire_cd = 0
	emit(state, "steroid_started", { ship = ship.index })
end

local function apply_pickup(state, ship, pickup)
	if pickup.kind == "life" then
		state.rebuilds = math.min(cfg.pickups.life_max, state.rebuilds + 1)
	elseif pickup.kind == "repair" then
		state.planet_integrity = math.min(100, state.planet_integrity + cfg.pickups.repair)
	elseif pickup.kind == "armor" then
		ship.armor = true
	elseif pickup.kind == "rapid" then
		if ship.weapon ~= "steroid" then
			ship.weapon = "rapid"
			ship.weapon_timer = cfg.pickups.rapid_duration
		end
	elseif pickup.kind == "spread" then
		if ship.weapon ~= "steroid" then
			ship.weapon = "spread"
			ship.weapon_timer = cfg.pickups.spread_duration
		end
	elseif pickup.kind == "steroid" then
		begin_steroid(state, ship)
	end
	emit(state, "pickup_collected", { ship = ship.index, pickup = pickup.kind, x = pickup.x, y = pickup.y })
end

local function update_ship_weapon(state, ship, dt)
	if ship.weapon ~= "normal" then
		ship.weapon_timer = ship.weapon_timer - dt
		if ship.weapon_timer <= 0 then ship.weapon = "normal" end
	end
	ship.fire_cd = ship.fire_cd - dt
	if ship.fire_cd > 0 or ship.invulnerable > 0 then return end
	local steroid = ship.weapon == "steroid"
	local interval = steroid and cfg.pickups.steroid_fire_interval
		or (ship.weapon == "rapid" and 0.24 or cfg.ship.fire_interval)
	ship.fire_cd = interval
	if ship.weapon == "spread" or steroid then
		local spread = steroid and cfg.pickups.steroid_spread or 0.18
		local damage = steroid and cfg.pickups.steroid_damage or 1
		fire_bullet(state, ship, ship.angle - spread, damage)
		fire_bullet(state, ship, ship.angle, damage)
		fire_bullet(state, ship, ship.angle + spread, damage)
	else
		fire_bullet(state, ship, ship.angle)
	end
	emit(state, "shot", { ship = ship.index, x = ship.x, y = ship.y })
end

local function update_ships(state, input, dt)
	for index, ship in ipairs(state.ships) do
		if ship.alive then
			local left, right
			if index == 1 then
				left = input.ship_a_left
				right = input.ship_a_right
			else
				left = input.ship_b_left
				right = input.ship_b_right
			end
			local steer = (left and 1 or 0) - (right and 1 or 0)
			if steer ~= 0 then
				ship.angle = (ship.angle + steer * cfg.ship.turn_speed * dt) % TAU
			end
			ship.x = ship.x + dm.cos(ship.angle) * cfg.ship.speed * dt
			ship.y = ship.y + dm.sin(ship.angle) * cfg.ship.speed * dt
			wrap(ship)
			ship.invulnerable = math.max(0, ship.invulnerable - dt)
			update_ship_weapon(state, ship, dt)
		elseif ship.respawn_timer > 0 then
			ship.respawn_timer = ship.respawn_timer - dt
			if ship.respawn_timer <= 0 then respawn_ship(state, ship) end
		end
	end
end

local function update_bullets(state, dt)
	for _, bullet in ipairs(state.bullets) do
		if not bullet.dead then
			bullet.prev_x, bullet.prev_y = bullet.x, bullet.y
			bullet.x = bullet.x + bullet.vx * dt
			bullet.y = bullet.y + bullet.vy * dt
			bullet.life = bullet.life - dt
			if bullet.life <= 0 or bullet.x < cfg.world_left - 30
				or bullet.x > cfg.world_right + 30
				or bullet.y < -30 or bullet.y > cfg.height + 30 then
				bullet.dead = true
			else
				local other = state.ships[bullet.owner == 1 and 2 or 1]
				local hit_t, hit_ship, hit_asteroid
				if other.alive and other.invulnerable <= 0 then
					hit_t = segment_circle_t(
						bullet.prev_x, bullet.prev_y, bullet.x, bullet.y,
						other.x, other.y, other.radius + bullet.radius)
					hit_ship = hit_t ~= nil
				end
				for _, asteroid in ipairs(state.asteroids) do
					if not asteroid.dead then
						local asteroid_t = segment_circle_t(
							bullet.prev_x, bullet.prev_y, bullet.x, bullet.y,
							asteroid.x, asteroid.y, asteroid.radius + bullet.radius)
						if asteroid_t and (not hit_t or asteroid_t < hit_t) then
							hit_t, hit_ship, hit_asteroid = asteroid_t, false, asteroid
						end
					end
				end
				if hit_t then
					bullet.dead = true
					if hit_ship then
						kill_ship(state, other, "friendly_fire", bullet.owner)
					else
						damage_asteroid(state, hit_asteroid, bullet.damage or 1, "bullet", bullet.owner)
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

local function update_asteroids(state, dt)
	for _, asteroid in ipairs(state.asteroids) do
		if not asteroid.dead then
			local dx, dy = cfg.cx - asteroid.x, cfg.cy - asteroid.y
			local distance = math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy)
			if distance > 0.0001 then
				local max_distance = math.sqrt(cfg.arena_x * cfg.arena_x + cfg.arena_y * cfg.arena_y)
				local proximity = 1 - clamp(distance / max_distance, 0, 1)
				local gravity = cfg.asteroid_gravity.outer_acceleration
					+ (cfg.asteroid_gravity.inner_acceleration - cfg.asteroid_gravity.outer_acceleration) * proximity
				asteroid.vx = asteroid.vx + dx / distance * gravity * dt
				asteroid.vy = asteroid.vy + dy / distance * gravity * dt
				local speed = math.sqrt(asteroid.vx * asteroid.vx + asteroid.vy * asteroid.vy)
				local max_speed = cfg.asteroids[asteroid.tier].speed * cfg.asteroid_gravity.speed_multiplier
				if speed > max_speed then
					asteroid.vx = asteroid.vx / speed * max_speed
					asteroid.vy = asteroid.vy / speed * max_speed
				end
			end
			asteroid.x = asteroid.x + asteroid.vx * dt
			asteroid.y = asteroid.y + asteroid.vy * dt
			asteroid.rotation = asteroid.rotation + asteroid.spin * dt
			asteroid.collision_cd = math.max(0, asteroid.collision_cd - dt)
			asteroid.player_tag_timer = math.max(0, asteroid.player_tag_timer - dt)
			if asteroid.player_tag_timer <= 0 then asteroid.player_tag_owner = nil end
			local limit = cfg.planet_radius + asteroid.radius * 0.72
			if length_sq(asteroid.x - cfg.cx, asteroid.y - cfg.cy) <= limit * limit then
				asteroid.dead = true
				state.stats.planet_hits = state.stats.planet_hits + 1
				if asteroid.tier == "large" then
					state.planet_integrity = 0
					emit(state, "planet_destroyed", { tier = "large", x = asteroid.x, y = asteroid.y })
					game_over(state, "catastrophic_impact")
				else
					local damage = cfg.asteroids[asteroid.tier].planet_damage
					state.planet_integrity = math.max(0, state.planet_integrity - damage)
					emit(state, "planet_hit", {
						tier = asteroid.tier,
						damage = damage,
						integrity = state.planet_integrity,
						x = asteroid.x,
						y = asteroid.y,
					})
					if state.planet_integrity <= 0 then
						emit(state, "planet_destroyed", { tier = asteroid.tier, x = asteroid.x, y = asteroid.y })
						game_over(state, "planet_integrity")
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

local function collide_ships(state)
	for _, ship in ipairs(state.ships) do
		if ship.alive then
			local planet_limit = cfg.planet_radius + ship.radius * 0.75
			if length_sq(ship.x - cfg.cx, ship.y - cfg.cy) <= planet_limit * planet_limit then
				kill_ship(state, ship, "planet_collision")
			end
			for _, asteroid in ipairs(state.asteroids) do
				local rr = ship.radius + asteroid.radius
				if not asteroid.dead and distance_sq(ship, asteroid) <= rr * rr then
					if steroid_active(ship) then
						damage_asteroid(state, asteroid, cfg.pickups.steroid_damage, "ship_collision")
					elseif kill_ship(state, ship, "asteroid_collision") then
						damage_asteroid(state, asteroid, 2, "ship_collision")
					end
					break
				end
			end
		end
	end
	local a, b = state.ships[1], state.ships[2]
	if a.alive and b.alive then
		local rr = a.radius + b.radius
		if distance_sq(a, b) <= rr * rr then
			kill_ship(state, a, "ship_collision")
			kill_ship(state, b, "ship_collision")
		end
	end
end

local function collide_asteroids(state)
	for i = 1, #state.asteroids - 1 do
		local a = state.asteroids[i]
		if not a.dead then
			for j = i + 1, #state.asteroids do
				local b = state.asteroids[j]
				if not b.dead then
					local rr = a.radius + b.radius
					local dx, dy = b.x - a.x, b.y - a.y
					local dist2 = dx * dx + dy * dy
					if dist2 > 0 and dist2 < rr * rr then
						local dist = math.sqrt(dist2)
						local nx, ny = dx / dist, dy / dist
						local overlap = rr - dist
						a.x, a.y = a.x - nx * overlap * 0.5, a.y - ny * overlap * 0.5
						b.x, b.y = b.x + nx * overlap * 0.5, b.y + ny * overlap * 0.5
						local rel = (b.vx - a.vx) * nx + (b.vy - a.vy) * ny
						if rel < 0 then
							local impulse = clamp(-rel * 0.72, 0, 95)
							a.vx, a.vy = a.vx - nx * impulse, a.vy - ny * impulse
							b.vx, b.vy = b.vx + nx * impulse, b.vy + ny * impulse
							if impulse > 34 and a.collision_cd <= 0 and b.collision_cd <= 0 then
								a.collision_cd, b.collision_cd = 0.35, 0.35
								damage_asteroid(state, a, 1, "collision")
								damage_asteroid(state, b, 1, "collision")
							end
						end
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

local function update_pickups(state, dt)
	for _, pickup in ipairs(state.pickups) do
		local magnet, magnet_distance
		for _, ship in ipairs(state.ships) do
			if pickup.life > 0 and ship.alive then
				local dx, dy = ship.x - pickup.x, ship.y - pickup.y
				local distance = dx * dx + dy * dy
				if distance <= cfg.pickups.magnet_radius * cfg.pickups.magnet_radius
					and (not magnet_distance or distance < magnet_distance) then
					magnet, magnet_distance = ship, distance
				end
			end
		end
		if magnet and magnet_distance > 0.0001 then
			local distance = math.sqrt(magnet_distance)
			local response = math.min(1, cfg.pickups.magnet_response * dt)
			local target_vx = (magnet.x - pickup.x) / distance * cfg.pickups.magnet_speed
			local target_vy = (magnet.y - pickup.y) / distance * cfg.pickups.magnet_speed
			pickup.vx = pickup.vx + (target_vx - pickup.vx) * response
			pickup.vy = pickup.vy + (target_vy - pickup.vy) * response
		end
		pickup.x = pickup.x + pickup.vx * dt
		pickup.y = pickup.y + pickup.vy * dt
		pickup.life = pickup.life - dt
		wrap(pickup)
		for _, ship in ipairs(state.ships) do
			local rr = pickup.radius + ship.radius
			if pickup.life > 0 and ship.alive and distance_sq(pickup, ship) <= rr * rr then
				apply_pickup(state, ship, pickup)
				pickup.life = 0
				break
			end
		end
	end
end

local function choose_spawn(state)
	local minute = state.elapsed / 60
	local roll = state.rng:next()
	local tier
	if state.elapsed >= cfg.director.large_unlock and roll < math.min(0.08 + minute * 0.012, 0.22) then
		tier = "large"
	elseif state.elapsed >= cfg.director.medium_unlock
		and roll < math.min(0.44 + minute * 0.025, 0.70) then
		tier = "medium"
	else
		tier = "small"
	end
	local side = state.rng:int(1, 4)
	local visual_radius = cfg.asteroids[tier].radius * 1.25
	local outside = visual_radius + cfg.asteroid_gravity.spawn_margin
	local x, y
	if side == 1 then x, y = cfg.world_left - outside, state.rng:range(65, cfg.height - 65)
	elseif side == 2 then x, y = cfg.world_right + outside, state.rng:range(65, cfg.height - 65)
	elseif side == 3 then x, y = state.rng:range(cfg.world_left + 65, cfg.world_right - 65), -outside
	else x, y = state.rng:range(cfg.world_left + 65, cfg.world_right - 65), cfg.height + outside end
	local aim_x = cfg.cx + state.rng:range(-400, 400)
	local aim_y = cfg.cy + state.rng:range(-260, 260)
	local angle = atan2(aim_y - y, aim_x - x) + state.rng:range(-0.32, 0.32)
	local speed = cfg.asteroids[tier].speed
		* (1 + math.min(minute * cfg.director.speed_ramp, cfg.director.speed_ramp_max))
	return tier, x, y, dm.cos(angle) * speed, dm.sin(angle) * speed
end

local PATTERN_IDS = {
	"pinch",
	"fan",
	"escort",
	"crossfire",
}

local function spawn_pattern_body(state, encounter_id, tier, side, lane, aim_offset)
	local visual_radius = cfg.asteroids[tier].radius * 1.25
	local outside = visual_radius + cfg.asteroid_gravity.spawn_margin
	local x, y
	if side == 1 then x, y = cfg.world_left - outside, cfg.cy + lane
	elseif side == 2 then x, y = cfg.world_right + outside, cfg.cy + lane
	elseif side == 3 then x, y = cfg.cx + lane, -outside
	else x, y = cfg.cx + lane, cfg.height + outside end
	local aim_x = cfg.cx + (side <= 2 and 0 or aim_offset)
	local aim_y = cfg.cy + (side <= 2 and aim_offset or 0)
	local angle = atan2(aim_y - y, aim_x - x)
	local speed = cfg.asteroids[tier].speed
		* (1 + math.min(state.elapsed / 60 * cfg.director.speed_ramp,
			cfg.director.speed_ramp_max))
	return spawn_asteroid(
		state, tier, x, y,
		dm.cos(angle) * speed,
		dm.sin(angle) * speed,
		encounter_id)
end

local function begin_pattern(state)
	state.pattern_index = state.pattern_index + 1
	local kind = (state.pattern_index - 1) % #PATTERN_IDS + 1
	local encounter_id = state.pattern_index
	state.encounter = {
		id = encounter_id,
		integrity = state.planet_integrity,
		failed = false,
		pattern = PATTERN_IDS[kind],
	}
	if kind == 1 then
		spawn_pattern_body(state, encounter_id, "small", 1, -250, -110)
		spawn_pattern_body(state, encounter_id, "small", 2, 250, 110)
	elseif kind == 2 then
		for _, lane in ipairs({ -310, 0, 310 }) do
			spawn_pattern_body(state, encounter_id, "small", 3, lane, lane * 0.28)
		end
	elseif kind == 3 then
		local side = state.pattern_index % 2 == 0 and 1 or 2
		spawn_pattern_body(state, encounter_id, state.elapsed < 42 and "small" or "medium", side, 0, 0)
		spawn_pattern_body(state, encounter_id, "small", side, -230, -150)
		spawn_pattern_body(state, encounter_id, "small", side, 230, 150)
	else
		spawn_pattern_body(state, encounter_id, "small", 1, -310, 150)
		spawn_pattern_body(state, encounter_id, "small", 2, 310, -150)
		spawn_pattern_body(state, encounter_id, "small", 3, -330, 130)
		spawn_pattern_body(state, encounter_id, "small", 4, 330, -130)
	end
	if state.pressure_tier >= 1 then
		local side = state.pattern_index % 4 + 1
		spawn_pattern_body(state, encounter_id, "medium", side, -180, 120)
	end
	if state.pressure_tier >= 2 then
		local side = (state.pattern_index + 2) % 4 + 1
		spawn_pattern_body(state, encounter_id, "medium", side, 180, -120)
	end
	emit(state, "encounter_started", { pattern = state.encounter.pattern })
end

local function update_encounter_bonus(state)
	local encounter = state.encounter
	if not encounter then return end
	if state.planet_integrity < encounter.integrity then encounter.failed = true end
	for _, asteroid in ipairs(state.asteroids) do
		if not asteroid.dead and asteroid.encounter_id == encounter.id then return end
	end
	if not encounter.failed and state.ships[1].alive and state.ships[2].alive then
		local bonus = 350 + math.min(state.phase - 1, 2) * 150
		state.score = state.score + bonus
		emit(state, "mastery_bonus", {
			pattern = encounter.pattern,
			amount = bonus,
		})
	end
	state.encounter = nil
end

local function spawn_opening_lanes(state)
	local visual_radius = cfg.asteroids.small.radius * 1.25
	local outside = visual_radius + cfg.asteroid_gravity.spawn_margin
	for _, ship in ipairs(state.ships) do
		local dx, dy = dm.cos(ship.angle), dm.sin(ship.angle)
		local x_edge = dx >= 0 and cfg.world_right + outside or cfg.world_left - outside
		local y_edge = dy >= 0 and cfg.height + outside or -outside
		local x_travel = math.abs(dx) > 0.0001 and (x_edge - ship.x) / dx or math.huge
		local y_travel = math.abs(dy) > 0.0001 and (y_edge - ship.y) / dy or math.huge
		local travel = math.min(x_travel, y_travel)
		local x, y = ship.x + dx * travel, ship.y + dy * travel
		local speed = cfg.asteroids.small.speed * 0.72
		spawn_asteroid(state, "small", x, y,
			-dx * speed, -dy * speed)
	end
	state.opening_lanes_spawned = true
end

local function warn_first_large(state)
	if #state.warnings >= cfg.limits.warnings then return false end
	local visual_radius = cfg.asteroids.large.radius * 1.25
	local outside = visual_radius + cfg.asteroid_gravity.spawn_margin
	local side = state.rng:int(1, 4)
	local x, y
	if side == 1 then x, y = cfg.world_left - outside, cfg.cy
	elseif side == 2 then x, y = cfg.world_right + outside, cfg.cy
	elseif side == 3 then x, y = cfg.cx, -outside
	else x, y = cfg.cx, cfg.height + outside end
	local angle = atan2(cfg.cy - y, cfg.cx - x)
	local speed = cfg.asteroids.large.speed * 1.06
	state.warnings[#state.warnings + 1] = {
		id = next_id(state),
		timer = cfg.director.large_warning,
		x = x,
		y = y,
		vx = dm.cos(angle) * speed,
		vy = dm.sin(angle) * speed,
		tier = "large",
	}
	state.first_large_spawned = true
	emit(state, "catastrophe_warning", {
		x = x,
		y = y,
		duration = cfg.director.large_warning,
	})
	return true
end

local function spawn_ship_pickup(state, kind, angle_offset, distance)
	local ship = state.ships[state.ships[1].alive and 1 or 2]
	local angle = ship.angle + angle_offset
	spawn_pickup(state,
		ship.x + dm.cos(angle) * distance,
		ship.y + dm.sin(angle) * distance,
		kind)
end

local function update_director(state, dt)
	local pressure_tier = math.min(cfg.director.expert_max,
		math.max(0, math.floor((state.elapsed - cfg.director.expert_start) / cfg.director.expert_step) + 1))
	if pressure_tier > state.pressure_tier then
		state.pressure_tier = pressure_tier
		emit(state, "pressure_advanced", { tier = pressure_tier })
	end
	if not state.opening_lanes_spawned and state.elapsed >= cfg.director.opening_lane_time then
		spawn_opening_lanes(state)
	end
	if not state.first_pickup_spawned and state.elapsed >= cfg.director.first_pickup then
		state.first_pickup_spawned = true
		spawn_ship_pickup(state, "rapid", 0.55, 180)
	end
	if not state.first_spread_spawned and state.elapsed >= cfg.director.first_spread then
		state.first_spread_spawned = true
		spawn_ship_pickup(state, "spread", -0.7, 205)
	end
	if not state.first_recovery_spawned and state.elapsed >= cfg.director.first_recovery then
		state.first_recovery_spawned = true
		local ship = state.ships[state.ships[1].alive and 1 or 2]
		local kind = state.planet_integrity < 75 and "repair" or "armor"
		spawn_pickup(state, ship.x + dm.cos(ship.angle + 0.55) * 130,
			ship.y + dm.sin(ship.angle + 0.55) * 130, kind)
	end
	if not state.first_steroid_spawned and state.elapsed >= cfg.director.first_steroid then
		state.first_steroid_spawned = true
		spawn_ship_pickup(state, "steroid", 0.82, 230)
	end
	if not state.first_large_spawned and state.elapsed >= cfg.director.first_large then
		warn_first_large(state)
	end
	local phase = state.elapsed % cfg.director.cycle
	local first_lull = state.elapsed >= cfg.director.first_recovery
		and state.elapsed < cfg.director.first_lull_end
	local recovery = phase >= cfg.director.pressure or first_lull
	if state.elapsed >= state.next_pattern_at and not recovery and not state.encounter then
		begin_pattern(state)
		local interval = math.max(cfg.director.pattern_interval_min,
			cfg.director.pattern_interval - state.pressure_tier * cfg.director.pattern_interval_step)
		state.next_pattern_at = state.elapsed + interval
	end
	if recovery and not first_lull and not state.was_recovery then
		local angle = state.rng:range(0, TAU)
		spawn_pickup(state, cfg.cx + dm.cos(angle) * 340, cfg.cy + dm.sin(angle) * 230,
			state.planet_integrity < 60 and "repair" or nil)
	end
	state.was_recovery = recovery
	state.spawn_timer = state.spawn_timer - dt
	if state.spawn_timer > 0 then return end
	local minute = state.elapsed / 60
	local interval = math.max(cfg.director.min_spawn,
		cfg.director.base_spawn - minute * cfg.director.spawn_ramp)
	if state.elapsed < cfg.director.opening_duration then
		interval = math.max(interval, cfg.director.opening_spawn)
	end
	if state.phase >= 2 then interval = interval * 0.86 end
	if recovery then interval = interval * 2.25 end
	state.spawn_timer = interval * state.rng:range(0.78, 1.22)
	local tier, x, y, vx, vy = choose_spawn(state)
	if tier == "large" and recovery then tier = "medium" end
	if tier == "large" then
		local large_count = 0
		for _, asteroid in ipairs(state.asteroids) do
			if not asteroid.dead and asteroid.tier == "large" then large_count = large_count + 1 end
		end
		if large_count >= 2 or #state.warnings >= cfg.limits.warnings then tier = "medium" end
	end
	if tier == "large" then
		state.warnings[#state.warnings + 1] = {
			id = next_id(state),
			timer = cfg.director.large_warning,
			x = x,
			y = y,
			vx = vx,
			vy = vy,
			tier = tier,
		}
		emit(state, "catastrophe_warning", { x = x, y = y, duration = cfg.director.large_warning })
	else
		spawn_asteroid(state, tier, x, y, vx, vy)
	end
end

local function update_warnings(state, dt)
	for _, warning in ipairs(state.warnings) do
		warning.timer = warning.timer - dt
		if warning.timer <= 0 and not warning.done then
			warning.done = true
			spawn_asteroid(state, warning.tier, warning.x, warning.y, warning.vx, warning.vy)
		end
	end
end

local function compact(list, predicate)
	local write = 1
	for read = 1, #list do
		local value = list[read]
		if predicate(value) then
			list[write] = value
			write = write + 1
		end
	end
	for i = #list, write, -1 do list[i] = nil end
end

local function cleanup(state)
	compact(state.bullets, function(v) return not v.dead end)
	compact(state.asteroids, function(v) return not v.dead end)
	compact(state.pickups, function(v) return v.life > 0 end)
	compact(state.warnings, function(v) return not v.done end)
end

function M.new_game(seed)
	return {
		status = "playing",
		game_over_reason = nil,
		last_loss_reason = nil,
		elapsed = 0,
		score = 0,
		combo = 0,
		combo_timer = 0,
		stats = {
			planet_hits = 0,
			ships_lost = 0,
			friendly_fire = 0,
			close_saves = 0,
		},
		planet_integrity = 100,
		rebuilds = cfg.ship.initial_rebuilds,
		pickup_meter = 0,
		spawn_timer = cfg.director.opening_spawn,
		opening_lanes_spawned = false,
		first_pickup_spawned = false,
		first_spread_spawned = false,
		first_recovery_spawned = false,
		first_steroid_spawned = false,
		first_large_spawned = false,
		was_recovery = false,
		phase = 1,
		pressure_tier = 0,
		pattern_index = 0,
		next_pattern_at = cfg.director.first_pattern,
		encounter = nil,
		next_id = 0,
		rng = rng_module.new(seed),
		ships = {
			new_ship(1, cfg.cx - 390, cfg.cy - 180, -0.66),
			new_ship(2, cfg.cx + 390, cfg.cy + 180, math.pi - 0.66),
		},
		asteroids = {},
		bullets = {},
		pickups = {},
		warnings = {},
		events = {},
	}
end

function M.step(state, input, dt)
	if state.status ~= "playing" then
		state.events = {}
		return state
	end
	state.events = {}
	if state.tutorial then
		update_ships(state, input or {}, dt)
		update_bullets(state, dt)
		cleanup(state)
		return state
	end
	state.elapsed = state.elapsed + dt
	state.combo_timer = math.max(0, state.combo_timer - dt)
	if state.combo_timer <= 0 then state.combo = 0 end

	update_director(state, dt)
	update_warnings(state, dt)
	update_ships(state, input or {}, dt)
	update_bullets(state, dt)
	update_asteroids(state, dt)
	collide_ships(state)
	collide_asteroids(state)
	update_pickups(state, dt)
	cleanup(state)
	update_encounter_bonus(state)

	local any_alive = state.ships[1].alive or state.ships[2].alive
	local any_waiting = state.ships[1].respawn_timer > 0 or state.ships[2].respawn_timer > 0
	if not any_alive and not any_waiting and state.rebuilds <= 0 then game_over(state, "fleet_lost") end
	return state
end

function M.finish_tutorial(state)
	state.tutorial = nil
	return state
end

M.segment_circle = segment_circle
M.spawn_asteroid = spawn_asteroid
M.spawn_pickup = spawn_pickup
M.damage_asteroid = damage_asteroid
M.kill_ship = kill_ship

return M
modules.scoreosis.codec:
-- Canonical, exact encoding of plain Lua data, shared by game clients and the
-- Scoreosis verifier. Numbers round-trip bit for bit; table keys are sorted,
-- so equal states always encode to equal strings.
local M = {}

local floor, frexp, ldexp, format = math.floor, math.frexp, math.ldexp, string.format
local concat, sort, byte, sub, find = table.concat, table.sort, string.byte, string.sub, string.find
local TWO53 = 9007199254740992
local NEG_ZERO = -1 / math.huge

local function encode_number(x)
	if x ~= x then return "N" end
	if x == math.huge then return "I" end
	if x == -math.huge then return "J" end
	if x == floor(x) and x > -TWO53 and x < TWO53 then
		if x == 0 and 1 / x < 0 then return "m" end
		return "i" .. format("%.0f", x) .. ";"
	end
	local m, e = frexp(x)
	return "f" .. format("%.0f", m * TWO53) .. "," .. format("%.0f", e - 53) .. ";"
end

local function key_less(a, b)
	local ta, tb = type(a), type(b)
	if ta ~= tb then return ta < tb end
	return a < b
end

local encode_value

local function encode_table(t, out, depth)
	if depth > 64 then error("codec: nesting too deep") end
	local keys = {}
	for k in pairs(t) do
		local kt = type(k)
		if kt ~= "string" and kt ~= "number" then error("codec: unsupported key type " .. kt) end
		keys[#keys + 1] = k
	end
	sort(keys, key_less)
	out[#out + 1] = "{"
	for i = 1, #keys do
		local k = keys[i]
		encode_value(k, out, depth)
		encode_value(t[k], out, depth)
	end
	out[#out + 1] = "}"
end

function encode_value(v, out, depth)
	local tv = type(v)
	if tv == "number" then
		out[#out + 1] = encode_number(v)
	elseif tv == "string" then
		out[#out + 1] = "s" .. #v .. ":" .. v
	elseif tv == "boolean" then
		out[#out + 1] = v and "t" or "b"
	elseif tv == "table" then
		encode_table(v, out, depth + 1)
	else
		error("codec: unsupported value type " .. tv)
	end
end

function M.encode(v)
	local out = {}
	encode_value(v, out, 0)
	return concat(out)
end

local function read_until(s, pos, ch)
	local stop = find(s, ch, pos, true)
	if not stop then error("codec: truncated input") end
	return sub(s, pos, stop - 1), stop + 1
end

local decode_value

function decode_value(s, pos, depth)
	local tag = sub(s, pos, pos)
	pos = pos + 1
	if tag == "i" then
		local digits, nxt = read_until(s, pos, ";")
		return tonumber(digits), nxt
	elseif tag == "f" then
		local body, nxt = read_until(s, pos, ";")
		local comma = find(body, ",", 1, true)
		return ldexp(tonumber(sub(body, 1, comma - 1)), tonumber(sub(body, comma + 1))), nxt
	elseif tag == "m" then
		return NEG_ZERO, pos
	elseif tag == "N" then
		return 0 / 0, pos
	elseif tag == "I" then
		return math.huge, pos
	elseif tag == "J" then
		return -math.huge, pos
	elseif tag == "t" then
		return true, pos
	elseif tag == "b" then
		return false, pos
	elseif tag == "s" then
		local len, start = read_until(s, pos, ":")
		local n = tonumber(len)
		return sub(s, start, start + n - 1), start + n
	elseif tag == "{" then
		if depth > 64 then error("codec: nesting too deep") end
		local t = {}
		while sub(s, pos, pos) ~= "}" do
			if pos > #s then error("codec: truncated input") end
			local k, v
			k, pos = decode_value(s, pos, depth + 1)
			v, pos = decode_value(s, pos, depth + 1)
			t[k] = v
		end
		return t, pos + 1
	end
	error("codec: bad tag at " .. (pos - 1))
end

function M.decode(s)
	local v, pos = decode_value(s, 1, 0)
	if pos ~= #s + 1 then error("codec: trailing data") end
	return v
end

-- Polynomial checksum mod 2^31-1; exact in doubles, needs no bit library.
function M.checksum(s)
	local h = 7
	for i = 1, #s, 64 do
		local chunk = { byte(s, i, i + 63) }
		for j = 1, #chunk do h = (h * 257 + chunk[j]) % 2147483647 end
	end
	return h
end

-- Inputs travel as "count:bits,count:bits" run-length pairs, one bitmask per tick.
function M.encode_inputs(ticks)
	local out, run, last = {}, 0, nil
	for i = 1, #ticks do
		local bits = ticks[i]
		if bits == last then
			run = run + 1
		else
			if last then out[#out + 1] = run .. ":" .. last end
			last, run = bits, 1
		end
	end
	if last then out[#out + 1] = run .. ":" .. last end
	return concat(out, ",")
end

return M
modules.scoreosis.detmath:
-- Deterministic trigonometry for ranked simulations.
-- Platform math libraries disagree in the last bits; these use only
-- IEEE-exact operations (+ - * / sqrt floor), so every runtime agrees.
local M = {}

local floor = math.floor
local PI = 3.14159265358979311600e+00
local PIO2 = 1.57079632679489655800e+00
local INV_PIO2 = 6.36619772367581382433e-01
local PIO2_1 = 1.57079632673412561417e+00
local PIO2_2 = 6.07710050630396597660e-11
local PIO2_3 = 2.02226624871116645580e-21
local PIO6 = 5.23598775598298815659e-01
local SQRT3 = 1.73205080756887719318e+00
local TAN_PIO12 = 2.67949192431122695616e-01

local function sin_kernel(r)
	local z = r * r
	return r + r * z * (-1.66666666666666324348e-01 + z * (8.33333333332248946124e-03
		+ z * (-1.98412698298579493134e-04 + z * (2.75573137070700676789e-06
		+ z * (-2.50507602534068634195e-08 + z * 1.58969099521155010221e-10)))))
end

local function cos_kernel(r)
	local z = r * r
	return 1 - 0.5 * z + z * z * (4.16666666666666019037e-02 + z * (-1.38888888888741095749e-03
		+ z * (2.48015872894767294178e-05 + z * (-2.75573143513906633035e-07
		+ z * (2.08757232129817482790e-09 + z * -1.13596475577881948265e-11)))))
end

local function reduce(x)
	local k = floor(x * INV_PIO2 + 0.5)
	return ((x - k * PIO2_1) - k * PIO2_2) - k * PIO2_3, k % 4
end

function M.sin(x)
	local r, q = reduce(x)
	if q == 0 then return sin_kernel(r) end
	if q == 1 then return cos_kernel(r) end
	if q == 2 then return -sin_kernel(r) end
	return -cos_kernel(r)
end

function M.cos(x)
	local r, q = reduce(x)
	if q == 0 then return cos_kernel(r) end
	if q == 1 then return -sin_kernel(r) end
	if q == 2 then return -cos_kernel(r) end
	return sin_kernel(r)
end

local function atan_series(t)
	local z = t * t
	local s = 1 / 29
	for n = 27, 1, -2 do s = 1 / n - z * s end
	return t * s
end

function M.atan(x)
	if x ~= x then return x end
	local negative = x < 0
	if negative then x = -x end
	local invert = x > 1
	if invert then x = 1 / x end
	local result
	if x > TAN_PIO12 then
		result = PIO6 + atan_series((x * SQRT3 - 1) / (x + SQRT3))
	else
		result = atan_series(x)
	end
	if invert then result = PIO2 - result end
	if negative then result = -result end
	return result
end

function M.atan2(y, x)
	if x > 0 then return M.atan(y / x) end
	if x < 0 and y >= 0 then return M.atan(y / x) + PI end
	if x < 0 then return M.atan(y / x) - PI end
	if y > 0 then return PIO2 end
	if y < 0 then return -PIO2 end
	return 0
end

M.pi = PI

return M
